updates.how: A completely new front wing design, aimed at improved flow conditioning towards the floor and bodywork resulting in improved aerodynamic performance.
A new rear wing assembly has been designed for this event, aiming to increase aerodynamic load efficiently in all conditions.
In conjunction with the aforementioned rear wing, a new beam wing has been designed for improved interaction and flow conditioning.
A small modification to the floor furniture, resulting in better flow conditioning and resultant improvement of aerodynamic performance of the floor.
